probe.text_sample: About David Alaba — Official Website menu close home journey about the david alaba foundation gallery press contact Instagram Twitter Tiktok Facebook The Athlete. Captain. Leader. Winner. Athlete. David Alaba is a world-class footballer and serial winner who has claimed over thirty trophies, including twelve league titles and four UEFA Champions Leagues. A ten-time Austrian Footballer of the Year, he has represented his country over a hundred times at all levels and has captained them at major International tournaments. But he has bigger and bolder ambitions, which reach far beyond football. The Athlete. Captain. Leader. Winner. Athlete. ■ Childhood Born in Vienna to a Nigerian father and a Filipino mother, he was a citizen of the world from the day he was born, and now speaks four languages: English, German, Tagalog and Spanish. He was raised in a household which had abundant love for music and fashion - his father was a DJ and recording artist, and his parents often dressed him up with influences from the world of African-American music - and these shaped the paths that he and his sister would later pursue.
